description: Render the local workflow catalogue as graph JSON and an HTML viewer, following main → write_outputs → build_model.

policy.claim_ceiling: Source-linked graph-rendering description only; no scientific result, runtime qualification or promotion is established.

sources.selector: main; write_outputs; load_catalogue; assemble_model; prepare_directory; publish_model; emit_report

gaps: Catalogue parsing, branch selection, finite graph traversals and HTML helpers remain inside their owning native operations.
The 3600-second ceiling and four-call ceiling are descriptor budgets, not native bounds. The registered CLI action has no timeout.

CLI argument parsing and hub preflight, dry-run and undeclared-write auditing remain native boundary behavior. MCP stages use the service write policy; this DAG represents the renderer after admission.

contract.summary: Render Mathformer workflow graph JSON and HTML reports.

mathformer.native_boundary.execution: Four registered MCP tools share the native renderer functions. The existing hub action continues to launch the original CLI entrypoint.
mathformer.native_boundary.options: RendererOptions retains the native main options. The registered hub invocation uses the default directory and json=true and rejects extra arguments. MCP writes are subject to service write policy; alternate paths need qualified authority.
mathformer.native_boundary.stopping: Hub preflight failure or dry-run stops before subprocess execution. Otherwise subprocess exit status determines success subject to the subsequent undeclared-write audit. Uncaught read/write/render errors terminate execution; prior mkdir or JSON writes are not rolled back. A relative_to(REPO_ROOT) failure can occur after both files are written.
mathformer.native_boundary.failure_policy: Return native failure status without acceptance; normal report is true and returns 0, while a false report would return 3.

mathformer.catalogue_semantics.ordering: Construct loop-contract workflows only when required_owner_skills is truthy; preserve first occurrence of owner skills. Append manual workflows only for absent stack IDs, updating existing_ids. Append integration workflow only if remaining ordered skills are nonempty.
mathformer.catalogue_semantics.branches: Names fall back to directory names. Loop descriptions use description or canonical fallback; step descriptions use skill description or hook trigger or humanized Run fallback. Integration skills sort by direct-route priority, then shared-runtime priority, then name; evidence chooses direct route, shared runtime, or project-local reporting.
mathformer.catalogue_semantics.carried_state: Manifest parsing carries section, current_hook, current_loop, current_list and accumulated hooks/contracts/routes; list extraction carries block/indent/list state. Catalogue assembly carries existing_ids and workflows; integration computes modeled and remaining skills.
mathformer.catalogue_semantics.bounds: Every traversal consumes finite discovered files, file lines, contracts, manual workflows or inventory entries. No retry, convergence test, explicit iteration budget, or native timeout.

mathformer.model_semantics.ordering: Create family nodes before workflow traversal. Per workflow initialize stack and reset previous_step_id=None; process steps in source order, then reflection records. Deduplicate nodes only after all workflows, keeping last node for each ID; preserve accumulated edges.
mathformer.model_semantics.branches: First step selects workflow_entry; later steps select workflow_sequence. Add skill_handoff only when previous_step_id is set, then update it. Reflection endpoints map to local step IDs or external IDs; append external nodes as needed. Either external endpoint selects reflective_external_reference, otherwise workflow_reflective_loop.
mathformer.model_semantics.carried_state: Carry nodes, edges, stacks, skill_use_counter and role_counter across workflows; carry previous_step_id across steps only within one workflow. Build step_by_skill after steps; later duplicate skills determine that lookup.
mathformer.model_semantics.bounds: Finite families, workflows, steps and reflection records; stop each traversal on input exhaustion and return model normally. Reflection edges are output data and never execute scientific refinement.
mathformer.model_semantics.outputs: Compute stack/hook/family counts, modeled/available/unmodeled/shared skills and reflection-role counts. Write workflow_graphs.json before workflow_graphs.html; report paths relative to REPO_ROOT.

mathformer.transport.model: GraphModel is insertion-order-preserving JSON text, decoded only at publication to retain native JSON and HTML byte order. Catalogue is also insertion-order-preserving JSON text containing serialized native workflow dataclasses. Context explicitly supplies the repository root.
mathformer.transport.observability: Native report printing is retained on MCP stderr to keep stdout reserved for protocol traffic. Lunar supplies call receipts and runtime provenance.
